title: Chapter 25 Enemies Don’T Get Together
content:
Chapter 25 Enemies Don’T Get Together

(asking for recommendation votes)

In fact, not only in the eyes of outsiders, Heifu's training method was seeking death. After standing there for a day, even Guishili made a strange sound...

The Taira family lives in the county town and is a middle-class family. They have not suffered much in normal times. Today, they were exposed to the scorching sun for a long time. Just to learn to stand, he sat on the straw couch, rubbed his sore feet, and began to complain softly. .

"This gentleman, Heifu, is indeed serving for the first time. I see that everyone else is practicing in a lively manner, except for us who stood there for a while. Uncle Chao is an old soldier. Please say something!"

Uncle Chao remained silent, and after a while he said, "Heifu's training methods are indeed very different from those I served in the past dozen times..."

"exactly!"

His words were approved by Ping, and the brothers Ke and Ke also nodded. They both felt that this training method was useless.

These words disappeared after Hei Fu and Dongmen Bao pushed in the door. In the past two days, the two people who were once incompatible with each other cherished each other and became closer day by day.

Although Dongmen Leopard has good personal martial arts and strength, he is slow to learn the rules of the army. Fortunately, he is not willing to lag behind others and is very strong. Therefore, Heifu would give him a small stove for half an hour in the afternoon. After all, as a corps leader, he must not make any mistakes. Finally, before sunset, the two of them would throw daggers at the tree stumps for entertainment.

After the chiefs and corps commanders united, all opposition voices only dared to mutter in secret and did not dare to complain in person.

But everyone didn't know that these words had already been heard by Ji Ying, who was pretending to sleep while holding the quilt.

Before nightfall, when Heifu went to the toilet, Ji Ying caught up with him and confided in him the complaints he heard while pretending to sleep.

"It doesn't matter. In two days, they will know the benefits of today's training." Heifu smiled and disagreed. A standard standing position is the basis of the formation. If you can't stand straight, what other complicated things are there? What about actions?

On the morning of the next day, October 4th, the sun rose again. On the school field, people like Hei Fu and others already know roughly where they should stand, and they don't have to go around looking for it like headless flies like yesterday.

In addition, everyone's standing barely met the standard, at least not crooked or slanted. Hei Fu did not dare to ask these Qin soldiers to be Wu Qianshou according to the standards of the police academy in his previous life.

So the whole morning's work was to learn to squat and stand at the same time under the leadership of Hei Fu. This is the "sitting up" in Wu Zi's Art of War.

Before a battle, there is a long period of formation of troops; after the forward troops go to fight, the reserve troops also have to wait for a long time, sometimes for several hours. For such a long time, of course, the soldiers cannot stand stupidly with their swords like in the costume TV series. Instead, they have to "sit", which is actually squatting, so as to save some energy.

In order to make the movements look uniform, Heifu made improvements and broke down the entire movements. When you hear "sit", don't squat down. Instead, take half a step back with your right feet together, then squat down and let your heels support your body. The same goes for "getting up".

With the foundation of standing yesterday, by the time of the meal, everyone in Quanshi can basically squat and stand up at the same time. Anyone who breaks the rhythm will be beaten mercilessly. Now even veteran Wu Chaobo was amazed, feeling that Heifu's training method was indeed much faster than his previous ten or twenty trainings.

However, from the perspective of the others, Heifu and the others still didn't do anything all morning. They just stood up and squatted on the same spot, squatted and squatted...

For a moment, the commanders and corps commanders who had been dissatisfied with Heifu's threat to win the championship all showed contempt, and began to feel that Heifu was just a boaster and had no real ability.

Heifu and the others from Jiashi next door, when passing by Guishi, suddenly shouted: "Isn't this Guishi who wants to win the first place in the competition? Why have you been ups and downs here all morning? Is it because you are too scared to walk?" Way out?"

Everyone in Guishi was laughed at, but most of them dared not speak out.

"How brave!" Only the irascible Dongmen Bao was furious. He almost jumped up and beat the booing people, but Heifu quickly held him tightly.

The person opposite Jia Shi was also scolded by his commander and stopped laughing jokingly.

"I was really offended just now." The well-dressed chief of Jiashi across from him took the initiative to come over and bowed to Heifu. He was slightly chubby and had a ruddy complexion, which was rare in a country with widespread malnutrition.

This was the first time he communicated with other Shi Shi, Hei Fu responded: "I am Gui Shi Shi Chang Hei Fu, I don't know how you call me..."

"I am an expert in armor, with a high rank. I have served many times, and I am also an old soldier."

The visitor seemed polite, but one could clearly feel his arrogance. After all, his title was one level higher than that of Hei Fu, and he was also much older. Moreover, judging from his clothes, especially the belt around his waist, with various patterns and the The bronze beast also holds a turquoise stone in its mouth.

Heifu visually estimated that this belt alone was worth at least seven to eight hundred dollars, which was more expensive than his own clothes. Well, this guy looks like a rich guy.

"My name is Yuan Bai." The man introduced himself.

"Yuan Bai?" Heifu thought about this name. He seemed to have heard it somewhere. After a while, he suddenly remembered it!

The name of Yuan Bai seems to have been mentioned in a TV show in his previous life. Isn't he the guy who lent money to the Heifu brothers in the military camp, and then tried his best to collect the debts, forcing them to write letters home asking for help! I never thought that we would meet here. That sentence is really true. It’s not that enemies never get together...

Yuan Bai was not polite, and after a few casual greetings, he made his intention clear.

"Chief Hei Fu and Gui Shi won the first place in the competition. They are very confident. Do you really want General Bin Bai to jump and dance on the school field?"

Heifu was not modest either. He smiled and said, "I won't say anything that I'm not sure about."

Yuan Bai was surprised, he didn't believe it, but he still said kindly: "Since you are so confident, why not take the opportunity to compete with me, Jia Shi?"

"Jia Shi wants to compete with Guishi?"

After hearing Yuan Bai's purpose, Heifu became wary and looked at this rich-looking guy with a rosy face.

"The ten-day competition is originally about ten people doing assessments and comparisons in front of the county captain. What else is there to compete against?"

Yuan Bai shook his head and said with a smile: "The competition I'm talking about is that you and I have made an agreement. If there is a competition in ten days, Guishi will be the first, so what if Guishi doesn't come first..."

Heifu understood a little. He was just here to have a fight. When he was in the police academy in his previous life, there were often competitions between classes. If he lost, he would have to treat him to a meal or something...

But Yuan Bai had a big appetite. He stretched out a finger and said, "If Guishi wins first place, I will give you one thousand dollars. If Guishi doesn't come first, you give me one thousand dollars. How about that?"

One thousand coins happened to be the reward Heifu got from the official temple for capturing the thief. This guy named Yuan Bai was very good at calculation.

Heifu was well aware of his training, and of course he was not afraid of Yuan Bai. He just played hard to get and showed hesitation. He shook his head and said: "This is inappropriate. I heard that Qin's law said that if the people gamble, they will be punished by two armors." of."

"This is not gambling!"

Yuan Bai quickly explained: "You and I are not playing games, playing chess, betting pots, but using money as a reward to encourage each other to train. This is a good thing, how can we call it gambling? If you don't believe it, I We can also ask officials from the government to come as witnesses and help us sign the deed!"

"Is that so?" Heifu said with a smile, "If that's the case, I'd be willing to give it a try, but..."

"Just what?"

Heifu looked at the valuable belt around Yuan Bai's waist and said with a smile: "It's only a thousand dollars, too little!"
